ideas.children_he: בִּמְקוֹם כַּעַס יָבוֹאוּ נֶחָמָה וִישׁוּעָה. הָעָם יוֹדֶה לַה׳ וְיִבְטַח בּוֹ בְּלִי פַּחַד.
ideas.children_en: Comfort and rescue will replace anger. The people will thank God and trust him without fear.

ideas.children_he: הָעָם נִקְרָא לְהוֹדוֹת לַה׳ וּלְסַפֵּר לַכֹּל עַל מַעֲשָׂיו. הַשִּׁיר יְפַרְסֵם אֶת גְּדֻלָּתוֹ.
ideas.children_en: The people are called to thank God and tell everyone about his deeds. Their song will make his greatness known.

ideas.children_he: אַנְשֵׁי צִיּוֹן נִקְרָאִים לִשְׂמֹחַ, כִּי קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּקִרְבָּם.
ideas.children_en: Zion's people are called to rejoice because the Holy One of Israel is among them.
